_source: OSRS Wiki: Pay-to-play Runecraft training (blood/soul runes in Arceuus table), Blood Altar (Kourend), Soul Altar (Kourend), Dark essence fragments, Dark essence block, Blood essence, Abyssal lantern, Raiments of the Eye. Read 2026-11-13.
_rates: Hourly xp is the wiki's, with the medium Kourend & Kebos diary and running to the altar. Each dark essence block gives 2.5 xp at the Dark Altar and chisels into 4 fragments; one fragment makes one rune.
_essence: An active blood essence gives a 50% chance of one extra blood rune per fragment, no extra xp, 1,000 extra runes per essence.
